name: Comic Pop
tagline: code-video's comic: cream newsprint, Ben-Day halftone, Bangers shouts in red, yellow and blue, hard ink borders.

motion.direction: code-video `comic`. Cream newsprint with Ben-Day halftone; Bangers shout words in red `ter` with hard 4 px ink borders and offset shadows, yellow `gold` speech-bubble captions (spoken word boxed), blue `goldd` for the calm panel. Panels cut hard; every landing is held poses (on twos); a `stamp` POW / NOPE / TRUE on verdicts, `strikeLine` as a marker scratch, `counter`s in a burst; `bleedPlate` for the splash page. Loud, flat, no gradients; one gag per panel.
